Isometric Stone Soup
Author: Screaming Brain Studios
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain)
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/isometric-stone-soup

Tiles are derived from the CC0 Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup tile set
(also public domain), converted to isometric 64x32.

Selected tiles in this folder were cropped and converted to GIF for the
Tk client; magenta background was made transparent.
